summary: Stellar Bancorp files an 8-K disclosing litigation related to its pending merger with Prosperity Bancshares under the Merger Agreement dated January 27, 2026. Under the deal, Stellar will merge into Prosperity, with Prosperity as the surviving corporation, followed by the merger of their banking subsidiaries. Three shareholder lawsuits filed in New York Supreme Court allege disclosure deficiencies in the proxy statement/prospectus. Stellar and Prosperity believe the claims are meritless. Prosperity filed an S-4 effective April 21, 2026; Stellar's special shareholder meeting is set for May 27, 2026. Watch for potential supplemental disclosures or settlement to smooth regulatory and shareholder approval.
